english.title: Sell non-prepacked raw milk at a catering establishment without the required label / mark / ticket / notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold raw milk, which was not prepacked, at a catering establishment without

(A)_[a label attached to the container in which that milk was sold]_
(B)_[displaying a ticket or notice that was readily discernible by an intending purchaser at the place where the purchaser chose that milk]_

with the words "Milk supplied in this establishment has not been heat-treated and may therefore contain organisms harmful to health. The Food Standards Agency strongly advises that it should not be consumed by children, pregnant women, older people or those who are unwell or have chronic illness."
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 17(3A) of, and paragraph 1B and 7B of Schedule 6 to, the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: In relation to raw milk sold in other circumstances (e.g. prepacked / at a supermarket etc.) see offence document H11861 (CJS code FG06020).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
